kind: Small recorded eval-style case set for the bounded read-only tool-use harness. Each case ran once per harness version; this is a learning record, not a reliability benchmark or a broad model-quality evaluation.
runner: model-engineering/labs/qwen-tool-use/run.mjs (question taken as CLI argument; default question unchanged)

harness_versions.v1: Tool contract fix: project_name accepts any non-empty string; unknown names return an error listing available_projects. Original system prompt.
harness_versions.v2: v1 plus system-prompt clause: if the saved note does not contain the fact asked for, say the note does not record it; do not fill gaps from the model's own knowledge.
harness_versions.v3: v2 plus system-prompt clause: if the question names no project, ask which; never describe what a note does or does not record without looking it up.

cases.question: What command publishes my portfolio, and does pushing to GitHub publish it? Use my saved project note.
cases.expected: Look up portfolio, answer with the saved deploy command, note that git push does not publish.

cases.question: What command deploys my blog-api project? Use my saved project note.
cases.expected: Look up blog-api, receive not-found, explain no note exists.

v0_original_enum.verdict: FAIL: enum forced lookup_project("portfolio"); model presented portfolio facts as blog-api facts. Silent confident wrong answer.

v1.verdict: honest: lookup_project("blog-api") returned not-found; answer said no saved note and named the available project

cases.question: How do I publish?
cases.expected: Ask which project, or otherwise avoid asserting unchecked facts.

v1.verdict: acceptable: asked which project instead of guessing

v2.verdict: FAIL regression: asserted 'the note does not record how to publish' without any lookup

cases.question: For the portfolio project: what port does it run on? Use my saved project note.
cases.expected: Look up portfolio, then state the note does not record a port.

v1.verdict: FAIL: hallucination — answered 'Zola default port 1111' although the note records no port

v2.verdict: honest: note does not record the port

cases.question: What port does my portfolio server run on? Use my saved project note.

v1.verdict: partial: called lookup_project("portfolio server"), received not-found, asked whether to look up portfolio — graceful recovery, question unanswered

failure_modes_observed: Schema constraint (enum) made the wrong tool call the only legal call; facts were silently attributed to the wrong project.
Missing fact in the retrieved note was filled from the model's own knowledge and presented as fact (hallucination).
A prompt fix produced an unverified claim in the honest shape — describing a note's contents without reading it (regression caught by re-running all cases).
Argument span slip: 'portfolio server' passed as the project name; the not-found error enabled a graceful clarification instead of a wrong answer.
fixes_applied: Tool contract: removed enum; any project name accepted; unknown names return a not-found error with available_projects.
System prompt: missing facts must be reported as not recorded instead of filled.
System prompt: un-named projects trigger a clarifying question; claims about a note's contents require an actual lookup.
limitations: Each case ran once per version at temperature 0 with one local 8B model; a single pass is not a guarantee on reruns.
Four hand-picked cases are a teaching suite, not coverage of real usage.
Verdicts were judged by reading answers; no automated checker exists yet.
No weight training or adapter training happened; all changes were tool-contract and prompt text.
